findings.finding: The register is bound to the wrong code and is still exhaustive only by its own declaration. The windows describe removed or moved native resampling calls of the observation reader: OBSERVATION_ENFORCEMENT_DESIGN.md:141-150, with ':226 R12 owns reader changes', and section 2's baseline 'Accepted conformance main 3a81c8f...'. ENFORCEMENT_FEASIBILITY.md:173 says 'against the exact product revision', and :192 assigns the 'Exhaustive direct/indirect trace mapping' to the R12 temporal reader successor. Yet the record names 'the exact R10 operator revision in W05's release set, with harness-onion main at that time' and never the R12 conformance reader. The schema carries one candidateRepository and candidateRevision, with no baseline (old) revision for the oldTracePosition values and no second revision for the enforcement that the exclusion proofs rely on. boundaryInventory is written by the register's author, with no tie to an independent derivation such as A07's 'independent changed-symbol/test map' or the baseline-to-candidate diff, so check_register's coverage check only proves consistency with a self-chosen list. The record also does not say how W04-7, after W05, gets a reader revision with removed calls when the reader successor is W07.
findings.requiredChange: Name the reader repository and its baseline and candidate revisions, alongside the R10 enforcement revision the exclusion proofs depend on. Add the baseline revision and an inventory source (path and sha256 of the independent changed-symbol map, or a rule deriving it from the diff) to the schema. State which reader candidate W04-7 maps, and why it is available after W05 and before W07, or move the fill point.

findings.location: scripts/enforcement_test_plan.py docstring and check_plan; README 'Round-1 findings and dispositions' R1-7
findings.finding: The model claims more than it checks. The docstring says check 'checks content against the pinned sources: each group carries the matrix row's exact cases', but it stores only the matrix cell text and requires one case citing the brief. In scratch, with the derived texts recomputed, it accepted: dropping ENOSPC from TG-03 (N01); dropping 4 of TG-07's 5 matrix cases (N02); dropping every counterexample 18-28 case (N03) and the TG-08 section 4.4 case (N04); moving the section 8 and 6.3 native cases of TG-02, TG-03 and TG-08, the round-1 R1-1 fix, to before W06 (N05); running TG-03's owner-implementation cases W04_OFFLINE, before any release exists (N06); garbage case sources (N07); clearing TG-06's blockedBy (N08); dropping the planeon-a2.json pin, the R1-5 fix (N09), or every I05 file but status.json (N10); emptying TG-04's contracts (N11); moving the E09 case to TG-08 (N12); and an arbitrary window candidate, independence rules, W04-7 'now' and TG-04 in packet W04-2 (N13-N16). The current data is right, as checked by hand below, but the guard the R1-1, R1-4, R1-5 and R1-7 dispositions rely on is not there.
findings.requiredChange: Either pin by value the case sets per group (matrix cases, section 4.4 vectors, section 8 items with their W06 phase, counterexamples 18-28 with their groups), the required contract files (at least planeon-a2.json and each contract's model and vectors), blockedBy, the packet assignment, the W04-7 timing and the independence rules, or narrow the docstring and the R1-7 disposition to what is actually checked.

findings.finding: check_register takes `schema` but never uses it and does no schema validation. It accepted an INDIRECT window that is its own parent (R02), a parent cycle with no DIRECT root (R03), windows with no required fields besides id, kind, boundary and parentWindow (R04), duplicate inventory entries (R05), an empty register (R06), and a register without candidateRepository, candidateRevision or exhaustive (R07). check_window_schema checks key sets but not property constraints: it accepted removing minLength from exclusionProof and candidateRepository, nestedChecksRemoved retyped as a string, boundaryInventory without uniqueItems, and obligations widened to any string (S01-S05). The README's statement that 'check_register enforces unique ids, inventory coverage and parents' holds only for those three properties.
findings.requiredChange: Validate the register against the schema in check_register, or re-check the required fields, types and non-empty values in code. Require INDIRECT parents to resolve to a DIRECT root with no cycle or self-reference. Check the schema's property constraints by value.

findings.location: traceability.json TG-01 case 'exact fields ... through a narrow adapter, any implementation's frame codec' (W04_OFFLINE)
findings.finding: Before W05 the only implementation frame codec is W03 source or work in progress, which the independence rules forbid W04 to read or run. So the implementation half of this case cannot be W04_OFFLINE. The offline half, and the 'host data contracts replay' case, run the adopted reference models against their own vectors, which repeats harness-onion's validators and is not independent evidence.
findings.requiredChange: Split the case: reference-model replay stays W04_OFFLINE (recorded as a contract self-consistency check, not implementation evidence), and the implementation codec part runs AFTER_W05_RELEASE_SET against the released build.

findings.location: traceability.json testGroups blockedBy (TG-04, TG-05, TG-07; W06 cases of TG-02, TG-03, TG-08)
findings.finding: Only TG-06 is blocked by D-W02A-F2. That open item ('a production W02a backend profile with these components' canonical paths, confined types and verity digests ... before any evidence record') and native qualification v3 P7(a) ('No production profile exists until W03 adds one') block every native case that targets the enrolled host's exact paths, types and digests too.
findings.requiredChange: Add D-W02A-F2 (and the production native profile) to blockedBy for every group or case with W06 cases, or record why they are not blocked.

findings.location: traceability.json w03Inputs; README R1-5 disposition; packet ordering
findings.finding: The selection record is pinned only by path and sha256. Its source commit (104b115) and review state are not recorded, although the independence rule allows only 'reviewed records'. With a worktree-only reader, check() crashes with FileNotFoundError rather than a ValueError refusal (it needs the record from packet 221). Nothing records that W04-0 must not merge before packet 221. The model is also wired into no validator, so nothing on main runs it.
findings.requiredChange: Record the source commit and review state in w03Inputs. Make W04-0's merge depend on packet 221 (or serve the pinned commit explicitly). Turn a read failure into a refusal. State whether and when check() is wired into a validator.

findings.requiredChange: Add the trusted-code boundary declaration and resource-substitution to the E09 case.
